locked_decisions: Ontarch owns graph/bin generation; Takogami owns projection and routing only.
takogami graph is read-only by default: no child spawn, no operational command record, no implicit ontarch sync.
Graph freshness binds exact upstream bytes via registry_generation.source_fingerprints (units/policies/profiles/skills).
Global --json always means one CommandEnvelope; graph --format selects payload rendering.
Supported bin ops reuse S6.1 executor/record/stream pipeline; no second subprocess runner.
Evaluator-owned dual-Allow authorization preserved; generalize private runnable payload only.
Durable RuntimeCommandRecord schema 0.1.0 remains compatible; omit lifecycle resolution for bin; no breaking migration without addendum.
Dry-run remains Gate/no-spawn; archive/delete deferred_unavailable + Deny before Ontarch invoke.
No approval transport, human-actor inference, or archive/delete execution in S7.
